facts.fact: Bank Al-Maghrib decision n° 265/W/2026 of 6 July 2026 cut the cap on domestic card interchange fees from 0.65% (set October 2024) to 0.50%, effective 1 October 2026, and BAM supervises payment establishments against its security, continuity and reliability requirements for payment services; the joint communiqué names no payments law and gives its own date 2026-07-10.

Bank Al-Maghrib and the Competition Council state that newly licensed payment establishments (établissements de paiement) and already licensed ones are deploying card-acquiring activity in Morocco, with BAM overseeing them; the communiqué is dated 2026-07-10 and gives no licensing dates.
